body.x: StockFolio (CEO Yeonwoo Linslet Oh) showcased its AI-powered video production solution, Pixt AI, at CES 2025, held from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, USA. This innovative technology creates customized marketing videos in under a minute using text inputs, capturing the attention of global corporate representatives attending the event.

At CES, StockFolio demonstrated the capabilities of Pixt AI through proof-of-concept (PoC) tests. By inputting text resources such as URLs, PDFs, or DOCX files, the system automatically analyzes the target audience and generates tailored videos. Pixt AI’s ability to produce videos in various formats, from short-form to long-form, received widespread acclaim from industry professionals.

The solution integrates AI-generated voice narration, offering a seamless, one-stop video production process. During CES, StockFolio highlighted practical applications across various industries, showcasing the versatility of Pixt AI.

In a presentation titled "The Fusion of AI and Video Production," CEO Yeonwoo Linslet Oh stated, "We have entered an era where anyone, regardless of expertise, can create their videos. Pixt AI has significantly lowered the barriers to video production."

StockFolio reported receiving an unexpected range of collaboration proposals across multiple industries during the exhibition. These proposals included use cases in specialized fields that are challenging to address with traditional video production methods.

The public sector expressed particular interest in the technology. A U.S. state police department proposed developing a system to analyze body cam footage and generate reports automatically. Meanwhile, a high-security facility inquired about a solution to distribute videos to specific customers selectively using a proprietary CDN.

The private sector also presented numerous innovative applications. A global crowdfunding platform is exploring the integration of Pixt AI into its marketing services, while the education industry showed interest in generating personalized learning content. In healthcare, the focus was on developing video systems for patient education.

StockFolio stated, "We received far more diverse and specific application proposals than expected. We are preparing pilot projects and partnerships with several companies and institutions, primarily in the western United States. Leveraging the explosive interest confirmed at CES, we plan to accelerate our entry into the North American market."

They added, "International companies showed significant interest in the ability to mass-produce customized videos. Pixt AI’s technology was highly praised, as it analyzes target customer characteristics to create optimized videos automatically."

Global corporations highlighted Pixt AI’s video production system's scalability as a key differentiator. Its ability to create multiple versions of content efficiently and extensive database of Asia-focused video resources were recognized as standout features.

A representative from a global company remarked, "Traditional video production methods require significant time and cost to create customized content for different markets. Pixt AI has the potential to revolutionize this process." StockFolio is currently in discussions with several global companies about detailed collaboration plans.
Following CES, StockFolio plans to use subsequent negotiations to establish a foothold for its expansion into the North American market.
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
